text:
Gold Price in 1971
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1971, the LBMA gold price rose 14.7% between 1971-01-29 ($38.05) and 1971-12-31 ($43.63). The highest sampled price was $43.63 in December and the lowest was $38.05 in January. The mean of these observations was $40.97. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1971:
President Nixon suspended the dollar's convertibility to gold, ending the Bretton Woods system and letting the gold price float freely.
